title: 第一百五十六章 最疼爱的孙女，交到王大壮手上！
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

村里那些老太太天天在她耳边念叨自己家的孙子多么多么优秀，她听听就算了，从来不往心里去。

可王大壮不一样，这孩子不是嘴上说的好，是做出来的好。

她把湿漉漉的手在围裙上擦了擦，拉着王大壮的胳膊往外走，另一只手还不忘把灶火调小，盖上锅盖让小龙虾继续收汁。

“走，陪奶奶坐会儿，厨房的事不急，让虾在锅里多焖一会儿，更入味。”

两个人在客厅的沙发上坐下来，孙奶奶拿起茶壶给王大壮倒了一杯新茶，茶汤金黄透亮，热气袅袅升起。

陈大猛不由得开口询问道：“奶奶，孙爷爷去哪了？”

“大壮，你孙爷爷去药堂了。刚才接到电话，有个急诊病人需要他去看一眼，走得急，就没等你下来，他说下午就回来。”孙奶奶笑呵呵地解释道。

王大壮点了点头，端起茶杯喝了一口，茶很香，是今年的新龙井，豆香浓郁，回甘悠长。

孙奶奶靠在沙发上，犹豫片刻后终于开口道：“大壮，奶奶想问你个事。”

“奶奶你说。”王大壮放下茶杯认真回应道。

“就是菲菲的病，现在到底怎么样了？奶奶看你给她扎针，还下楼运动，气色也好多了。奶奶看得出来，她在慢慢好起来，这是不是表示菲菲快好了？”

王大柱却是斟酌一会儿开口道：“奶奶，按理说的确快好了，菲菲很愿意配合治疗，所以进度非常快。明天我再给她治疗最后一个疗程，抑郁症这边基本就差不多了。以后她不会再无缘无故地情绪低落，不会再有自杀的念头，不会再有那种活着没有意义的绝望感。”

孙奶奶的手微微发抖，眼眶泛红，可脸上却挂上笑容，“大壮，那真是太好了。只要菲菲愿意积极治疗，不管多久，奶奶都愿意陪她一起面对。一年、两年、十年，奶奶都陪着她。”

“奶奶，菲菲的病已经没有大碍了。”王大壮却笑着解释道：“癌细胞已经被我控制住了，只要按时吃药，大概半个月到一个月就能痊愈。等吃完一个疗程，你带她去市里的医院做个脑部检查，拍个片子，就能看到结果了。”

孙奶奶听后心里的石头总算落了下来，紧随着眼泪不争气地流出。

不是嚎啕大哭，是无声地流泪，眼泪顺着脸颊往下淌。

content_en:
Page (1/3)

The old ladies in the village kept talking to her about how outstanding their grandsons were every day, but she just listened and never took it seriously.

But Wang Dazhuang is different. This kid is not just good by what he says, but by what he does.

She wiped her wet hands on her apron, took Wang Dazhuang's arm and walked out. With her other hand, she did not forget to turn down the stove heat, cover the pot and let the crayfish continue to collect juice.

"Come on, sit with grandma for a while. There is no rush in the kitchen. Let the shrimps simmer in the pot for a while to make them more delicious."

The two of them sat down on the sofa in the living room. Grandma Sun picked up the teapot and poured Wang Dazhuang a cup of new tea. The tea soup was golden and translucent, and the steam was rising.

Chen Dameng couldn't help but ask: "Grandma, where has Grandpa Sun gone?"

"Dazhuang, your grandpa Sun went to the medicine hall. He just received a call that there was an emergency patient who needed him to see him. He was walking in a hurry, so he didn't wait for you to come down. He said he would be back in the afternoon." Grandma Sun explained with a smile.

Wang Dazhuang nodded, picked up the teacup and took a sip. The tea was very fragrant. It was this year's Xinlongjing. It had a rich bean aroma and a long aftertaste.

Grandma Sun leaned on the sofa, hesitated for a moment and finally said: "Dazhuang, grandma wants to ask you something."

"Grandma, tell me." Wang Dazhuang put down his tea cup and responded seriously.

"It's Feifei's illness. How is it now? Grandma sees you giving her acupuncture and going downstairs to exercise, and her complexion is much better. Grandma can see that she is slowly getting better. Does this mean that Feifei is getting better soon?"

Wang Dazhu thought about it for a while and then said: "Grandma, it stands to reason that she is getting better soon. Feifei is very willing to cooperate with the treatment, so the progress is very fast. I will give her the last course of treatment tomorrow, and the depression is basically gone. In the future, she will no longer be depressed for no reason, no longer have suicidal thoughts, and no longer have that sense of despair that life is meaningless."

Grandma Sun's hands were shaking slightly, her eyes were red, but there was a smile on her face, "Da Zhuang, that's great. As long as Feifei is willing to take active treatment, no matter how long it takes, grandma is willing to face it with her. For one year, two years, or ten years, grandma will be with her."

"Grandma, Feifei's illness is no longer serious." Wang Dazhuang explained with a smile: "I have controlled the cancer cells. As long as you take medicine on time, you will be cured in about half a month to a month. After finishing a course of treatment, you take her to the city hospital for a brain examination and a X-ray, and you will see the results."

After hearing this, the stone in Grandma Sun's heart finally fell, and tears flowed out unsatisfactorily.

Not crying loudly, but crying silently, with tears flowing down her cheeks.
